simple.meaning: סַבְתְּכָא (Çabtᵉkâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Sabteca , the name of a son of Cush, and the region settled by him.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: סַבְתְּכָא (H5455) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:7, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סַבְתְּכָא (H5455) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in סַבְתְּכָא (H5455) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: סַבְתְּכָא (Çabtᵉkâʼ) / H5455 is traced through Genesis 10:7, 1 Chronicles 1:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
